copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 可通过 WhatsApp 官方 API 收发消息，实现一对一聊天。该技能会复制并注册 WhatsApp 适配器、安装依赖，并引导配置凭据和 Webhook。
howto.when: 当用户要求把 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp、添加 WhatsApp 云 API 通道，或需要配置相关凭据/Webhook 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp 官方 API。
say.note: 技能会复制适配器并注册通道。

say.text: 添加 WhatsApp 云 API 通道，并配置好环境变量。
say.note: 会提示输入令牌和 ID 并写入 .env。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw gets a WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel: the skill copies and registers the adapter, installs the dependency, and guides credential/webhook setup so users can chat 1:1 via WhatsApp.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to connect NanoClaw to WhatsApp, add the WhatsApp Cloud API channel, or configure its credentials/webhook.

say_en.text: Connect NanoClaw to the WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
say_en.note: The skill copies and registers the adapter.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud API channel and set up environment variables.
say_en.note: It prompts for tokens and writes them to .env.

say_en.text: Set the webhook to /webhook/whatsapp-cloud and verify it.
say_en.note: It starts the webhook server and tests the callback.
